content.text: Totally normal at 28 months, since a lot of toddlers get wary of green food around now. Try putting a tiny piece of something green on his plate next to a food he already likes, with no pressure to eat it. Let him touch it, smell it, or ignore it. It often takes a dozen or more calm exposures before it gets tasted. Letting him help wash or tear the greens can speed that up. If you ever want to point me at a program to sign him up for, I can try that now once you say yes.
